'''Hanco''' was a [[sargheet]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagro]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He suffered through rough economic times and became frustrated with the seeming lack of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] support the planet received. Therefore, he confronted [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], along with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], arrived on the planet to [[Mission to Dagro|investigate]] a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist base (Dagro)|base]] and became stranded on the planet.

When Hanco witnessed the Jedi assisting the stripping of crops, he felt the Jedi worthy of the farmers's support. With the other farmers, Hanco, Kenobi and Skywalker located the last Separatist [[crawl-carrier]], destroying it before it could wipe out another village.
